source: A Night Off design doc pp. 8-13 (Patrons: types, traits, the thirty regulars, the generator's parts) and pp. 40-42 (conversation math, patron AI). Arrival and leaving hours, haunts and looks are ours. Hours run 19 (7 p.m.) to 27 (3 a.m.).

Talker.want: To tell you about their life
Talker.approach: Ask questions; buy a drink; listen

Flirt.danger: Some of them are the kidney thieves

Brooder.approach: Don't; or buy one drink and say nothing
Brooder.danger: Antagonized, they fight, and they're tough

Hustler.approach: Play them at pool or darts; they're good

Regular.danger: Taking the stool starts a feud

Gambler.approach: Sit at poker; they lose big and borrow

Sailor.approach: Rivalry: they'll race you at anything
Sailor.danger: A rival crew means a brawl at midnight

Oddball.approach: Talk to them; they have the best stories

regulars.name: Old Marlow
regulars.secret: Was the Marguerite's captain; knows the safe's combination

regulars.name: Dottie Finch
regulars.secret: A kidney thief, and the best in town

regulars.name: The Reverend
regulars.secret: Boxed professionally; a fortune can make him fight anyone

regulars.name: Sly Pennick
regulars.secret: Scratches his ear before a bluff

regulars.name: Big Ruth
regulars.secret: Owns her stool; buys rounds for anyone who sits beside it, not on it

regulars.name: Little Ruth
regulars.secret: Big Ruth's wife; jealous of anyone who flirts with Big Ruth

regulars.name: Harrow
regulars.secret: Owes the cartel; will frame a player

regulars.name: Captain Vane
regulars.secret: A rival captain; a darts match with him is the night's main event on quiet nights

regulars.name: Mother Quill
regulars.secret: The fortune teller's mother; knows what the cards really mean

regulars.name: Tam the Cook
regulars.secret: Will sell you the frying pan and the back-door key

regulars.name: Nellie Bright
regulars.secret: A genuinely nice night out; the morning line is kind

regulars.name: Jasper Coil
regulars.secret: A kidney thief who works with Dottie

regulars.name: The Twins
regulars.secret: Finish each other's sentences; buying one a drink buys both

regulars.name: Deacon Pale
regulars.secret: Lost a brother at sea; the one patron who can calm the Reverend

regulars.name: Pip
regulars.secret: A child-sized adult who sells scratch-offs out of a coat; lucky tickets

regulars.name: Mrs. Albright
regulars.secret: Her husband is at the bachelor party; tells you where it is

regulars.name: Cutter Jones
regulars.secret: Starts the midnight brawl if any rival crew is in

regulars.name: Lady Severine
regulars.secret: Rich; going home with her is a mansion, a butler, and a dawn chase by her husband

regulars.name: Bosun Grieve
regulars.secret: Teaches pool for a pint

regulars.name: The Widow Tusk
regulars.secret: Her late husband haunts the snug (a sound-only ghost)

regulars.name: Finnegan
regulars.secret: Marks cards; catching him is a story

regulars.name: Sister Ash
regulars.secret: A nun who drinks water and throws the hardest punch in the bar

regulars.name: Mr. Lemmon
regulars.secret: Will pay your tab if you listen for ten minutes

regulars.name: Red Haddock
regulars.secret: Throws darts left-handed when nervous

regulars.name: Juno Marsh
regulars.secret: Flirting back ends with her setting you up with someone

regulars.name: The Lamplighter
regulars.secret: Only here between 7 and 8; knows the night's crowd curve

regulars.name: Bartholomew Crane
regulars.secret: The cartel's informant; a decent poker player

regulars.name: Sweet Wren
regulars.secret: The nicest person in the bar; going home with her is a cup of tea and a lecture

regulars.name: Boxer Mags
regulars.secret: Fights for fun, buys you a drink after
